newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kirch to up stake in Premiere to 62.5 pct - paper.
newsitem.headline: Kirch to up stake in Premiere to 62.5 pct - paper.

text.p: German media firm Leo Kirch has agreed to buy an extra 37.5 percent stake in pay TV channel Premiere from its current French holder, Canal Plus , the German magazine Focus said in its weekend edition.

The stake, which Focus said was worth around one billion marks, would bring Kirch's total holding in Premiere to 62.5 percent. The remaining 37.5 percent is held by Kirch's German rival Bertelsmann AG.
A spokesman for Bertelsmann told Reuters on Saturday that he was not aware of the deal, but added that any agreement between Kirch and Canal Plus would also be subject to approval by Bertelsmann.
No-one at Kirch was available for comment.
Recent media speculation has suggested that Canal Plus was keen to divest its stake in Premiere, a joint Kirch/Bertelsmann pay TV channel.
Britain's BSkyB had appeared to be poised to take a 25 percent stake in Premiere last year, but then switched its focus to DF1, Kirch's digital operation.
